entries.zh: 认罪；据所见迹象招认（招供、承认）
entries.en: to confess upon indications/evidence; to admit, confess (one's guilt)

entries.zh: 错认；错认（误认）、认错对象（或：承认本不欲承认之事）
entries.en: to mistake/misrecognize; to confess what one did not wish to admit
entries.notes: 西语 confessar lo que no queria 与汉字'錯認'不完全对应，取错认为主义并附西语义。

entries.zh: 供罪；逐项招供、供认罪名
entries.en: to confess each charge; to confess one's crime(s)

entries.zh: 供认罪；供认罪行、招认罪状
entries.en: to confess/acknowledge one's crime

entries.zh: 口词多；供词繁多、口供中说的话多（话多好辩）
entries.en: to have much to say in confession; to be talkative, have many words (of statement/plea)

entries.zh: 已被招认；因嫌疑而指向他人、怀恨（食認＝已被认下/记恨）
entries.en: already confessed; to turn against others on suspicion, to bear a grudge
entries.notes: 西语 confessado ya 与'食認'及后接短语对应关系仅可推断。

entries.zh: 替；信赖他人、托付（信赖）
entries.en: to trust in another; to substitute for
entries.notes: 汉字'替'本义为替代，此处西语 confiar en otro 下作'信赖/托替'解；官话音栏 T99。

entries.zh: 靠；依靠、倚靠他人
entries.en: to rely on, depend on another
entries.notes: 闽南栏 [残]（go: co: 污损难辨），依赖汉字与西语栏判断。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（汉字疑为'彼'）依靠某人；信赖
entries.en: [manuscript damaged, gloss uncertain] to rely on that (person); to trust
entries.notes: 闽南栏全残，汉字栏标 [疑:彼]，仅西语栏 confiar en otro 可据。

entries.zh: 倚；倚靠、依赖
entries.en: to lean on, rely on, trust in
entries.notes: 闽南与官话音栏均 T99 污损，凭汉字'倚'与西语栏释义。

entries.zh: 恃；恃、依恃（有所倚仗）
entries.en: to rely on, count on; to presume upon

entries.zh: 换；换易、转换（用于托付/交换语境）
entries.en: to change, exchange
entries.notes: 汉字'换'与西语 confiar en otro 语义不直接对应，官话栏 othuan 亦存疑，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 怙伊扶持；倚仗他（伊）扶持、靠人扶助
entries.en: to rely on his/its support; to lean on another's backing

entries.zh: 省顧怙（疑为'皆'）；信赖、照管倚仗（把指望放在他物/他人之上）
entries.en: to confide, set one's hope/trust in another or in another thing
entries.notes: 西语栏西文残缺（tener puestas [残]），汉字栏有 [疑:皆]。

entries.zh: 管顧怙；照管、看顾、倚仗
entries.en: to look after, take care of; to rely on, trust in

entries.zh: 恃势；倚仗权势、仗势
entries.en: to presume upon one's power/influence; to rely on (another's) authority

entries.zh: 缔交；结交、缔结交情（与人相交相亲）
entries.en: to form a bond/friendship; to ally oneself with

entries.zh: 倚靠；倚靠、依靠
entries.en: to lean on, rely on, depend on

entries.zh: 倚赖；倚赖、依靠（插入补注'托赖'）
entries.en: to rely on, depend on (with inserted note: to trust/commit oneself to)

entries.zh: 倚势；倚仗势力、仗势
entries.en: to rely on power/influence; to presume upon one's position

entries.zh: 托赖；托赖、仰赖（依靠他人庇护）
entries.en: to rely on, commit oneself to (another's protection); to trust in
